QUOTE: A bad declaration does not fall back silently in the CLI. `cli.py` (around line 807) calls `declared_scope_rejection` and exits 1, because a silent fall-back would give the widest scope for the narrowest request.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer never says the fallback carries a reason string explaining which scope was used and why. It only describes the rejection of a bad declaration and the tier structure.
